nodes.notes: Son of David's brother Shimea; slew the six-fingered giant of Gath.

nodes.name: Abishai (Eldest Son of Zeruiah; Chief of David's Mighty Thirty, 1 Chr 2:16)
nodes.notes: Saved David from Ishbi-benob and led the vanguard at Rabbah.

nodes.name: General Joab (Son of Zeruiah; Commander of Israel's Armies, 1 Chr 2:16)
nodes.notes: Nephew of David and commander-in-chief throughout his reign.

nodes.name: Asahel (Son of Zeruiah; Swift-Footed Mighty Man, 2 Sam 2:18)
nodes.notes: Youngest son of Zeruiah, slain by Abner at Gibeon.

nodes.name: Jether / Ithra the Ishmaelite (Husband of Abigail bat Jesse, 1 Chr 2:17)
nodes.notes: Ishmaelite husband of David's sister Abigail.

nodes.name: General Amasa (Son of Jether & Abigail bat Jesse, 2 Sam 17:25)
nodes.notes: Appointed commander by Absalom and later by David before being slain by Joab.

nodes.name: King Amaziah of Judah (9th King, 796–767 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of King Joash & Jehoaddan; father of King Uzziah.

nodes.name: King Jotham of Judah (11th King, 750–735 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of King Uzziah & Jerusha bat Zadok; rebuilt Upper Gate of the Temple.

nodes.name: King Ahaz of Judah (12th King, 735–715 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of King Jotham; father of King Hezekiah; attested in Tiglath-Pileser III inscriptions as Yauhazi.

nodes.name: King Amon of Judah (15th King, 643–641 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of King Manasseh & Meshullemeth; father of King Josiah.

nodes.name: Prince Johanan (Eldest Son of King Josiah, 1 Chr 3:15)
nodes.notes: Eldest of Josiah's four sons listed in 1 Chr 3:15.

nodes.name: King Jehoahaz / Shallum of Judah (17th King, 609 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of Josiah & Hamutal; reigned 3 months before being deposed to Egypt by Pharaoh Neco II.

nodes.name: King Zedekiah / Mattaniah (20th & Final King of Judah, 597–586 BCE)
nodes.role: Final Pre-Exilic Davidic Monarch of Judah
nodes.notes: Third son of Josiah (& Hamutal); blinded and deported when Nebuchadnezzar II destroyed Jerusalem in 586 BCE.

nodes.name: Queen Mahalath (Granddaughter of David; Wife of Rehoboam, 2 Chr 11:18)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Jerimoth ben David and Abihail bat Eliab; bore Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

nodes.name: Queen Maacah (Granddaughter of Absalom; Mother of King Abijah, 1 Kgs 15:2)
nodes.notes: Favorite wife of Rehoboam; bore King Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

nodes.name: Queen Zibiah of Beersheba (Mother of King Joash, 2 Kgs 12:1)
nodes.notes: Wife of Ahaziah and mother of King Joash.

nodes.name: Queen Jehoaddan of Jerusalem (Mother of King Amaziah, 2 Kgs 14:2)
nodes.notes: Wife of King Joash and mother of King Amaziah.

nodes.name: Queen Jecoliah of Jerusalem (Mother of King Uzziah, 2 Kgs 15:2)
nodes.notes: Wife of King Amaziah and mother of King Uzziah.

nodes.name: Queen Jerusha bat Zadok (Mother of King Jotham, 2 Kgs 15:33)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Zadok; wife of Uzziah and mother of King Jotham.

nodes.name: Queen Abi / Abijah bat Zechariah (Mother of King Hezekiah, 2 Kgs 18:2)
nodes.notes: Wife of King Ahaz and mother of reforming King Hezekiah.

nodes.name: Queen Hephzibah (Wife of Hezekiah; Mother of King Manasseh, 2 Kgs 21:1)
nodes.notes: Wife of King Hezekiah and mother of Manasseh.

nodes.name: Queen Meshullemeth bat Haruz of Jotbah (Mother of King Amon, 2 Kgs 21:19)
nodes.notes: Wife of Manasseh and mother of King Amon.

nodes.name: Queen Jedidah bat Adaiah of Bozkath (Mother of King Josiah, 2 Kgs 22:1)
nodes.notes: Wife of King Amon and mother of reforming King Josiah.

nodes.name: Queen Zebidah bat Pedaiah of Rumah (Mother of King Jehoiakim, 2 Kgs 23:36)
nodes.notes: Wife of Josiah and mother of King Jehoiakim.

nodes.name: Queen Hamutal bat Jeremiah of Libnah (Mother of Jehoahaz & Zedekiah, 2 Kgs 23:31, 24:18)
nodes.role: Queen Mother of Two Kings of Judah
nodes.notes: Wife of King Josiah; mother of both Jehoahaz and final king Zedekiah.

nodes.name: Queen Nehushta bat Elnathan of Jerusalem (Mother of Jehoiachin, 2 Kgs 24:8)
nodes.notes: Wife of Jehoiakim; deported to Babylon with her son King Jehoiachin in 597 BCE.

nodes.name: Azariah (Son 2 of Jehoshaphat, 2 Chr 21:2)
nodes.notes: Son of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.notes: Son of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.notes: Son of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.notes: Son of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.name: Michael (Son 6 of Jehoshaphat, 2 Chr 21:2)
nodes.notes: Son of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.name: Shephatiah (Son 7 of Jehoshaphat, 2 Chr 21:2)
nodes.notes: Son of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.name: Prince Shealtiel ben Jehoiachin (Father/Uncle of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:17; Matt 1:12)
nodes.role: Eldest Exilic Son of King Jehoiachin
nodes.notes: Eldest son of deported King Jehoiachin; legal father of Governor Zerubbabel.

nodes.name: Malchiram (Son 2 of Jehoiachin, 1 Chr 3:18)
nodes.notes: Second son of Jehoiachin in Babylon.

nodes.name: Pedaiah ben Jehoiachin (Son 3 of Jehoiachin; Biological Father of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:18–19)
nodes.notes: Son of Jehoiachin named as father of Zerubbabel and Shimei in 1 Chr 3:19 (Levirate link to Shealtiel).

nodes.name: Shenazzar / Sheshbazzar (Son 4 of Jehoiachin, 1 Chr 3:18; Ezra 1:8)
nodes.notes: Fourth son of Jehoiachin.

nodes.name: Jekamiah (Son 5 of Jehoiachin, 1 Chr 3:18)
nodes.notes: Fifth son of Jehoiachin.

nodes.name: Hoshama (Son 6 of Jehoiachin, 1 Chr 3:18)
nodes.notes: Sixth son of Jehoiachin.

nodes.name: Nedabiah (Son 7 of Jehoiachin, 1 Chr 3:18)
nodes.notes: Seventh son of Jehoiachin.

nodes.name: Governor Zerubbabel of Yehud (Rebuilder of Second Temple, 538–515 BCE; Ezra 3; Hag 1)
nodes.role: Governor of Judah & Rebuilder of the Second Temple
nodes.notes: Davidic governor who led the return from Babylon under Cyrus and rebuilt the Second Temple alongside High Priest Jeshua.

nodes.name: Meshullam (Son 1 of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:19)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Zerubbabel.

nodes.name: Hananiah (Son 2 of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:19, 21)
nodes.notes: Second son of Zerubbabel through whom Chronicles traces the post-exilic Davidic line to Anani.

nodes.name: Princess Shelomith (Daughter of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:19; Stamp Seal!)
nodes.role: Daughter of Governor Zerubbabel & Wife of Governor Elnathan
nodes.notes: Named daughter of Zerubbabel, corroborated by a 6th-c. BCE Yehud seal reading 'Belonging to Shelomith maidservant of Elnathan the Governor'!

nodes.name: Hashubah (Son 3 of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:20)
nodes.notes: Third son of Zerubbabel.

nodes.name: Ohel (Son 4 of Zerubbabel, 1 Chr 3:20)

nodes.notes: Seventh son of Zerubbabel.

nodes.name: Pelatiah (Son of Hananiah, 1 Chr 3:21)
nodes.notes: Son of Hananiah ben Zerubbabel.

nodes.name: Rephaiah (1 Chr 3:21)
nodes.notes: Post-exilic Davidic link.

nodes.name: Arnan (1 Chr 3:21)
nodes.notes: Post-exilic Davidic link.

nodes.name: Obadiah (1 Chr 3:21)
nodes.notes: Post-exilic Davidic link.

nodes.name: Shecaniah (1 Chr 3:21)
nodes.notes: Father of Shemaiah & Hattush.

nodes.name: Shemaiah ben Shecaniah (1 Chr 3:22)
nodes.notes: Father of Neariah.

nodes.name: Neariah ben Shemaiah (1 Chr 3:22–23)
nodes.notes: Father of Elioenai, Hizkiah & Azrikam.

nodes.name: Elioenai ben Neariah (Father of 7 Sons, 1 Chr 3:23–24)
nodes.notes: Father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.

nodes.name: Anani (Final Named Davidic Descendant in 1 Chr 3:24)
nodes.role: Last Person Listed in Chronicles' Davidic Genealogy
nodes.notes: Youngest son of Elioenai and final named person in the Old Testament genealogy of the House of David.

nodes.name: General Barak ben Abinoam (Kedesh-naphtali, Judg 4:6)
nodes.notes: Summoned by Judge Deborah from Naphtali; routed Sisera at Mt. Tabor.

nodes.name: Heber the Kenite (Descendant of Hobab/Jethro, Judg 4:11)
nodes.notes: Descendant of Moses's father-in-law Hobab/Jethro; husband of Jael.

nodes.name: Jael (Wife of Heber the Kenite Who Slew Sisera, Judg 4:21)
nodes.role: Deliverer Celebrated in the Song of Deborah
nodes.notes: 'Most blessed of women' who struck down Canaanite commander Sisera with a tent peg.

nodes.name: Abimelech (Son of Gideon by Shechemite Concubine, Judg 9)
nodes.notes: Son of Gideon who seized rule at Shechem before falling at Thebez.

nodes.name: Jotham (Youngest Son of Gideon; Speaker of Fable of Trees, Judg 9:5–21)
nodes.notes: Sole survivor among Gideon's 70 sons who pronounced the Fable of the Trees on Mt. Gerizim.

nodes.name: 7. Judge Jair of Gilead (Manasseh, Judg 10:3–5)
nodes.notes: Gileadite judge for 22 years whose 30 sons rode 30 donkeys and governed Havvoth-jair.

nodes.name: 10. Judge Elon the Zebulunite (Judg 12:11–12)
nodes.notes: Buried at Aijalon in Zebulun after judging 10 years.

nodes.name: 11. Judge Abdon ben Hillel the Pirathonite (Judg 12:13–15)
nodes.notes: Ephraimite judge with 40 sons and 30 grandsons riding 70 donkeys.

nodes.name: Manoah of Zorah (+ Wife / Eluma; Parents of Samson, Judg 13)
nodes.notes: Danite of Zorah visited by the Angel of the Lord before Samson's birth.

nodes.name: Delilah of the Valley of Sorek (Judg 16:4–21)
nodes.role: Philistine Confidante Who Learned Secret of Samson's Vow
nodes.notes: Betrayed Samson to the five Philistine lords for 1,100 pieces of silver each.

nodes.name: Hophni (Son of Eli, 1 Sam 1:3, 4:11)
nodes.notes: Elder son of Eli slain when the Ark was captured at Aphek.

nodes.name: Phinehas ben Eli (+ Widow; Father of Ahitub & Ichabod, 1 Sam 4:19)
nodes.notes: Younger son of Eli; father of Ahitub and Ichabod.

nodes.name: Ichabod (Son of Phinehas ben Eli, 1 Sam 4:21)
nodes.notes: Born as his mother heard the Ark was taken ('No glory').

nodes.name: Ahitub ben Phinehas (1 Sam 14:3, 22:9)
nodes.notes: Son of Phinehas ben Eli; father of Ahiah/Ahimelech of Nob.

nodes.name: High Priest Ahimelech of Nob (Who Sheltered David, 1 Sam 21–22)
nodes.notes: Aided fleeing David with showbread & Goliath's sword before Doeg's massacre.

nodes.name: High Priest Abiathar ben Ahimelech (David's High Priest, 1 Sam 22:20)
nodes.role: Sole Survivor of Nob & Co-High Priest With Zadok
nodes.notes: Escaped Nob to serve David alongside Zadok; father of Jonathan & Ahimelech II.

nodes.name: Elkanah (Father of Prophet Samuel, 1 Sam 1:1; 1 Chr 6:34)
nodes.notes: Husband of Hannah and Peninnah; father of Samuel.

nodes.name: Hannah (Mother of Prophet Samuel, 1 Sam 1–2)
nodes.notes: Prayed silently at Shiloh and dedicated firstborn Samuel, later bearing 3 more sons and 2 daughters (1 Sam 2:21).

nodes.name: Joel / Vashni (Elder Son of Samuel; Father of Heman, 1 Sam 8:2; 1 Chr 6:33)
nodes.notes: Father of David's chief Temple musician Heman.

nodes.name: Abijah (Second Son of Prophet Samuel, 1 Sam 8:2)
nodes.notes: Younger son of Samuel.

nodes.name: Heman the Ezrahite / Singer (Grandson of Samuel; Chief Seer-Musician, 1 Chr 6:33, 25:5)
nodes.role: Davidic Temple Choir Master With 14 Sons & 3 Daughters
nodes.notes: Grandson of Prophet Samuel and leader of David's Temple music.

nodes.name: Abiel / Jeiel (Father of Kish & Ner, 1 Sam 9:1; 1 Chr 8:29)
nodes.notes: Benjaminite ancestor of King Saul and General Abner.

nodes.name: Kish ben Abiel (Father of King Saul, 1 Sam 9:1)
nodes.notes: Mighty Benjaminite of Gibeah; father of King Saul.

nodes.name: Ner ben Abiel (Uncle of Saul & Father of Abner, 1 Sam 14:50; 1 Chr 8:33)
nodes.role: Brother of Kish & Father of General Abner
nodes.notes: Benjaminite patriarch whose son Abner commanded Saul's army.

nodes.name: General Abner ben Ner (Commander of King Saul, 1 Sam 14:50; 2 Sam 3)
nodes.notes: Cousin of Saul; crowned Ish-bosheth before negotiating Israel's union with David.

nodes.name: Prince Abinadab / Ishvi (Son of Saul, d. Mt. Gilboa, 1 Sam 31:2)
nodes.notes: Slain beside father Saul and brothers at Mount Gilboa.

nodes.name: Prince Malchi-shua (Son of Saul, d. Mt. Gilboa, 1 Sam 31:2)
nodes.notes: Slain beside Saul and Jonathan at Mount Gilboa.

nodes.name: King Ish-bosheth / Esh-baal (Son of Saul, 2 Sam 2:8–4:7)
nodes.role: Successor of Saul Over Northern Israel
nodes.notes: Fourth son of Saul; reigned two years at Mahanaim.

nodes.name: Armoni & Mephibosheth II (Sons of King Saul & Rizpah, 2 Sam 21:8)
nodes.role: Sons of King Saul & Rizpah bat Aiah
nodes.notes: Guard-watched by their mother Rizpah on the rock of Gibeah.

nodes.name: Mica → Pithon, Melech, Tarea & Ahaz (1 Chr 8:35–40 Post-Jonathan Line)
nodes.role: Surviving Benjamite Line of Jonathan ben Saul
nodes.notes: Continues Jonathan's royal line through Ahaz -> Jehoaddah -> Alemeth/Azmaveth/Zimri -> Moza -> Binea -> Raphah -> Eleasah -> Azel -> Eshek -> Ulam.

nodes.name: Prophet Elisha ben Shaphat of Abel-meholah (1 Kgs 19:16; 2 Kgs 2–13)
nodes.notes: Received Elijah's double portion; anointed Jehu of Israel and Hazael of Damascus.

nodes.name: Prophet Zephaniah ben Cushi (Great-Great-Grandson of King Hezekiah, Zeph 1:1)
nodes.role: Royal Davidic Prophet Under King Josiah
nodes.notes: Zeph 1:1 explicitly traces Cushi -> Gedaliah -> Amariah -> King Hezekiah!

nodes.name: Shear-jashub (Elder Son of Prophet Isaiah, Isa 7:3)
nodes.notes: Accompanied Isaiah to meet King Ahaz ('A remnant shall return').

nodes.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz (Younger Son of Isaiah & the Prophetess, Isa 8:3)
nodes.notes: Named before Damascus and Samaria fell to Assyria.

nodes.name: Baruch ben Neriah (Scribe of Jeremiah; Brother of Seraiah, Jer 36, 51:59)
nodes.notes: Wrote Jeremiah's dictated scroll and left two authentic Jerusalem clay bullae ('Berekhyahu ben Neriyahu ha-Sofer')!

nodes.name: Prophet Ezekiel ben Buzi (Zadokite Priest Exiled to Tel-abib, Ezek 1:3)
nodes.notes: Exiled with King Jehoiachin in 597 BCE to the Kebar canal in Babylonia.

nodes.name: Hananiah / Shadrach, Mishael / Meshach & Azariah / Abednego (Three Judean Youths, Dan 1–3)
nodes.notes: Exiled from Judah with Daniel and appointed administrators of Babylon province.

nodes.name: Governor Nehemiah ben Hacaliah (Cupbearer to Artaxerxes I, Neh 1:1)
nodes.notes: Cupbearer at Susa commissioned by Artaxerxes I to rebuild Jerusalem's walls.

nodes.name: Gomer bat Diblaim (Wife of Prophet Hosea, Hos 1:3)
nodes.role: Wife of Hosea & Mother of Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah & Lo-ammi
nodes.notes: Mother of three prophetic-sign children with Hosea.

nodes.name: Prophet Amos of Tekoa (760–750 BCE)
nodes.notes: Herdsman from Judahite Tekoa who prophesied at Bethel under Jeroboam II.

nodes.name: Prophet Jonah ben Amittai of Gath-hepher (2 Kgs 14:25; Jonah 1:1)
nodes.era: 8th c. BCE (2 Kgs 14:25; Book of Jonah)
nodes.notes: Zebulunite prophet of Gath-hepher whose mission to Nineveh is cited in Matt 12:40.

nodes.name: Prophet Micah of Moresheth (Mic 1:1)
nodes.notes: Contemporary of Isaiah who prophesied Messiah's birth in Bethlehem.

nodes.name: Prophet Habakkuk (Hab 1:1)
nodes.notes: Prophesied on the eve of the Neo-Babylonian rise.

nodes.name: Prophet Zechariah ben Berechiah ben Iddo (Zech 1:1; Ezra 5:1)
nodes.notes: Grandson of Iddo; encouraged Zerubbabel and Jeshua in rebuilding the Second Temple.

nodes.name: Prophet Haggai (Hag 1:1; Ezra 5:1)
nodes.notes: Called Zerubbabel and High Priest Jeshua to resume Temple construction in Darius I's 2nd year.

nodes.name: Prophet Malachi (Final OT Prophetic Scroll, Mal 1:1)
nodes.role: Final Canonical Prophet of the Old Testament
nodes.notes: Called post-exilic priesthood to covenant faithfulness.

nodes.name: Ahithophel of Giloh (Grandfather of Bathsheba; David's Counselor, 2 Sam 15, 23:34)
nodes.role: Royal Counselor & Maternal Grandfather of Bathsheba
nodes.notes: Father of Eliam (2 Sam 23:34) and grandfather of Queen Bathsheba.

nodes.name: Uriah the Hittite (Mighty Man of David; 1st Husband of Bathsheba, 2 Sam 11, 23:39)
nodes.notes: Honored Hittite soldier and first husband of Bathsheba.

nodes.name: Caleb ben Jephunneh the Kenizzite (Father of Achsah, Num 13; Josh 14)
nodes.notes: Companion spy with Joshua who inherited Hebron and gave daughter Achsah to Othniel.

nodes.name: Abihail (Uncle of Mordecai & Father of Queen Esther, Esth 2:15)
nodes.notes: Brother of Mordecai's father Jair; father of Hadassah / Queen Esther.

nodes.name: Queen Esther / Hadassah (Daughter of Abihail; Queen of Xerxes I, Esth 2–9)
nodes.role: Jewish Queen of the Achaemenid Persian Empire
nodes.notes: Orphaned daughter of Abihail raised by cousin Mordecai; wed Emperor Ahasuerus/Xerxes I and thwarted Haman's decree.

nodes.name: Queen Vashti (1st Consort of King Ahasuerus / Xerxes I, Esth 1:9)
nodes.notes: Deposed prior to the selection of Queen Esther.

nodes.name: Anak (Father of Sheshai, Ahiman & Talmai at Hebron, Num 13:22, 33)
nodes.notes: Son of Arba; father of the three Anakim clans of Hebron.

nodes.name: Jemimah (Eldest Fair Daughter of Job, Job 42:14)
nodes.notes: Eldest of Job's three post-trial daughters granted equal inheritance.

nodes.name: Keziah (Second Fair Daughter of Job, Job 42:14)
nodes.notes: Second of Job's three daughters ('Cassia').

nodes.name: Keren-happuch (Third Fair Daughter of Job, Job 42:14)
nodes.notes: Youngest of Job's three daughters.

nodes.name: Asaph ben Berechiah ('The Seer' & Chief Gershonite Psalmist, 1 Chr 6:39, 25:1)
nodes.notes: Ancestor of the post-exilic Sons of Asaph choir (Ezra 2:41).

nodes.name: Ethan / Jeduthun (Chief Merarite Psalmist, 1 Chr 6:44, 25:1)
nodes.notes: Third chief Levitical musician alongside Heman and Asaph.

nodes.name: Abiud (Son of Zerubbabel, Matt 1:13)
nodes.notes: Abiud (Son of Zerubbabel, Matt 1:13) in Matthew 1.

nodes.name: Eliakim (Matt 1:13)
nodes.notes: Eliakim (Matt 1:13) in Matthew 1.

nodes.name: Azor (Matt 1:13–14)
nodes.notes: Azor (Matt 1:13–14) in Matthew 1.

nodes.name: Zadok (Matt 1:14)
nodes.notes: Zadok (Matt 1:14) in Matthew 1.

nodes.name: Achim (Matt 1:14)
nodes.notes: Achim (Matt 1:14) in Matthew 1.
